The following working discussion records earlier planning. Its settled decisions carry forward; the coding requirement below is authoritative.
[WORKING_DISCUSSION_SUMMARY]
Settled design: use exact integers and one pass in supplied nondecreasing event order, without sorting or mutating payload/config. Begin at time0 with tokens=capacity. At EVERY event refill min(capacity, tokens+(t-previous_t)*rate), then advance previous_t even on rejection or oversized costs. Accept cost<=tokens and subtract; reject otherwise without spending. cost0 accepts even at capacity0. Return only {accepted, rejected, remaining, tokens}: original zero-based index lists, balance AFTER each event, final balance; empty payload leaves tokens=capacity. Capacity/rate come from the actual config. Fractional credits, rounding, separate queues, real clocks/timers, logging, reason fields and service wrappers were rejected or deferred. Make the required actual read and first write, then finish briefly under the unchanged coding contract.
[/WORKING_DISCUSSION_SUMMARY]
The unchanged coding requirement follows:
Task: Integer token bucket event reducer.
Create /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/solution.py containing def solve(payload, config). payload is a list of events with nonnegative integer t timestamps in nondecreasing order and nonnegative integer cost values. config capacity and rate are nonnegative integers. Begin at time0 with tokens equal to capacity. At EVERY event, first refill tokens by (t minus previous event timestamp) times rate, capped at capacity, then set previous timestamp to t. If cost <= tokens, accept and subtract cost; otherwise reject without spending any tokens. Oversized costs are rejected but still perform the refill and timestamp advance. Zero cost is accepted even at capacity0. Return {accepted, rejected, remaining, tokens}. accepted/rejected are zero-based payload indices in order; remaining contains the balance AFTER each event; tokens is the final balance (capacity for an empty payload). Use exact integer arithmetic and do not mutate payload or config.
The project contains /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/config.json with the configuration and one sample INPUT (no expected output). You must first make exactly one read tool call for path /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/config.json, with whole=true and raw=true, and consume its result. Then make exactly one write tool call for path /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/solution.py containing your complete implementation. These are the only allowed tools and paths. Do not call bash, list, edit, more, web, search, or any other tool. Do not read /Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/solution.py or any other file. No second write or correction is permitted. After the write, finish with a brief plain answer. External tests will run once after your first attempt; do not try to run them.

{"path":"/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/recipe-20261008/compaction-visible/bucket/solution.py","content":"def solve(payload, config):
    capacity = config["capacity"]
    rate = config["rate"]
    tokens = capacity
    previous_t = 0
    accepted = []
    rejected = []
    remaining = []
    index = 0
    for event in payload:
        t = event["t"]
        cost = event["cost"]
        elapsed = t - previous_t
        tokens = tokens + elapsed * rate
        if tokens > capacity:
            tokens = capacity
        previous_t = t
        if cost <= tokens:
            accepted.append(index)
            tokens = tokens - cost
        else:
            rejected.append(index)
        remaining.append(tokens)
        index = index + 1
    return {
        "accepted": accepted,
        "rejected": rejected,
        "remaining": remaining,
        "tokens": tokens,
    }
"}

It uses exact integer arithmetic, processes events in one pass, refills before every event, advances the timestamp even on rejection, and returns the accepted/rejected index lists, per-event remaining balances, and final token balance without mutating inputs.
